assets.name: Long Wang Village Day
assets.description: A quiet rural Chinese village street on an overcast day, drawn like a theatre backdrop. Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a pale grey-white overcast sky band, a row of small single-storey stone and timber village houses with sloped tile roofs standing shoulder to shoulder all at the same height, a narrow flat dirt path running edge to edge across the middle, and a flat grassy ground strip across the bottom. Every roofline and house front perfectly horizontal and unbroken from the left edge to the right edge, no receding side wall visible. Muted rural palette of grey stone, weathered brown timber and pale earth tones.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI (2026-08-03): người dùng thấy ảnh quá phức tạp (nhiều nhà, có lớp nhà phía sau). Đã tạo lại đơn giản hơn dưới tên "Long Wang Village Day V2" — chỉ vài căn nhà nằm ngang mặt đường, không có nhà phía sau. Đừng dùng entry này nữa.

assets.name: Long Wang Village Night
assets.description: The same quiet rural Chinese village street at night, drawn like a theatre backdrop. Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a dark navy night sky band with a few small pale stars, a row of small single-storey stone and timber village houses with sloped tile roofs standing shoulder to shoulder all at the same height, one or two windows glowing with warm dim lantern light, a narrow flat dirt path running edge to edge across the middle, and a flat dark ground strip across the bottom. Every roofline perfectly horizontal and unbroken edge to edge. Dark cold nighttime palette of deep navy, charcoal and warm dim yellow window light.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI (2026-08-03): cùng lý do với "Long Wang Village Day" — đã tạo lại đơn giản hơn dưới tên "Long Wang Village Night V2". Đừng dùng entry này nữa.

assets.name: Long Wang Village Day V2
assets.description: A quiet rural Chinese village street on an overcast day, drawn like a very simple theatre backdrop. Only two or three single-storey stone and timber houses stand side by side in a single row, their front walls facing directly toward the viewer, each with a plain sloped tile roof, all at exactly the same height. Nothing stands behind the houses at all — no second row of buildings, no distant rooftops, just plain empty pale grey-white overcast sky directly above the roofline. A wide flat dirt path fills most of the frame in front of the houses, running edge to edge, with a narrow flat grassy ground strip along the very bottom. Every roofline and house front perfectly horizontal and unbroken from the left edge to the right edge. Muted rural palette of grey stone, weathered brown timber and pale earth tones.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI (2026-08-03): người dùng so sánh với bản Night V2 và thấy dãy nhà KHÔNG tràn hết chiều ngang khung hình (còn hở đất/trời 2 bên), khác hẳn bản Night V2 tràn kín. Đã tạo lại dưới tên "Long Wang Village Day V3" ép rõ tràn hết cạnh-tới-cạnh. Đừng dùng entry này nữa.

assets.name: Long Wang Village Day V3
assets.description: A quiet rural Chinese village street on an overcast day, drawn like a very simple theatre backdrop. Only two or three single-storey stone and timber houses stand side by side in a single row, scaled up so the row of houses completely fills the frame from the far left edge to the far right edge with absolutely no gap of visible grass or open sky at either side — the same edge-to-edge width as a theatre backdrop flat, not a small cluster floating in the middle of the frame. Their front walls face directly toward the viewer, each with a plain sloped tile roof, all at exactly the same height. Nothing stands behind the houses at all — no second row of buildings, no distant rooftops, just plain empty pale grey-white overcast sky directly above the roofline. A wide flat dirt path fills most of the frame in front of the houses, running edge to edge, with a narrow flat grassy ground strip along the very bottom. Every roofline and house front perfectly horizontal and unbroken from the left edge to the right edge. Muted rural palette of grey stone, weathered brown timber and pale earth tones.

assets.name: Long Wang Village Night V2
assets.description: The same quiet rural Chinese village street at night, drawn like a very simple theatre backdrop. Only two or three single-storey stone and timber houses stand side by side in a single row, their front walls facing directly toward the viewer, each with a plain sloped tile roof, all at exactly the same height, one or two windows glowing with warm dim lantern light. Nothing stands behind the houses at all — no second row of buildings, no distant rooftops, just plain empty dark navy night sky with a few small pale stars directly above the roofline. A wide flat dirt path fills most of the frame in front of the houses, running edge to edge, with a narrow flat dark ground strip along the very bottom. Every roofline perfectly horizontal and unbroken from the left edge to the right edge. Dark cold nighttime palette of deep navy, charcoal and warm dim yellow window light.

assets.name: Village Market
assets.description: A small outdoor rural market street, drawn like a theatre backdrop. Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a pale overcast sky band, a row of simple wooden market stalls with striped fabric awnings all standing at the same height along one side, each stall holding a few simple woven baskets of produce, a flat dirt path strip running edge to edge, and a flat ground strip across the bottom. Every stall front perfectly horizontal and unbroken edge to edge, no receding side wall. Muted daytime palette of warm brown wood, faded red and cream awning stripes, pale earth tones.

assets.name: Foggy Mountain Trail
assets.description: A narrow dirt trail winding through a misty mountainside. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of pale grey-white fog completely swallowing the distant hills, midground layer of tall bare tree trunks fading into the fog, foreground layer of a narrow dirt trail bordered by low scrubby bushes running across the bottom of the frame. Dense heavy fog rolling low across the whole scene, muted cold palette of pale grey, muted green and soft white mist.

assets.name: Long Wang 18 Lakes Hillside
assets.description: A scenic hillside overlook above a chain of small lakes, a popular tourist spot. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of a series of pale blue-grey lakes nestled between low misty hills, midground layer of a grassy hillside slope with a few scattered rocks, foreground layer of a flat grassy hilltop clearing spanning the bottom of the frame. Soft overcast palette of pale blue, muted green and grey mist.

assets.name: Long Wang 18 Lakes Opposite Hilltop
assets.description: A second scenic hilltop at the same lake district, the viewpoint looking across toward a neighbouring hill. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of the same chain of pale blue-grey lakes nestled between low misty hills, midground layer of one distinct rounded grassy hill standing clearly apart across a shallow empty dip of lower ground, its bare grassy crown plainly visible, foreground layer of a flat grassy hilltop clearing spanning the bottom of the frame. Same soft overcast palette of pale blue, muted green and grey mist as the other hillside background, with the same simple scattered rock and grass shapes. The far hill must be clearly separated from the near foreground hilltop by the visible dip of lower ground between them, so the two hilltops plainly read as two separate places a short distance apart.
assets.notes: Bối cảnh ĐỐI DIỆN của 'Long Wang 18 Lakes Hillside' — cùng địa điểm nhưng là ngọn đồi A Fei ĐỨNG, nhìn sang đồi bên kia (nơi nhóm 5 người đứng). Tạo ra để tách câu kịch bản 'spotted a group ... then drew closer' thành 2 shot có vị trí không gian khác nhau (shot/reverse-shot) thay vì gộp làm 1 ảnh — xem RUNBOOK mục 8.2i.

assets.name: Misty Forest Interior
assets.description: Deep inside a dense misty forest. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of tall tree trunks fading into thick pale fog, midground layer of a dense cluster of bare and leafy tree trunks of varying width, foreground layer of a flat forest floor covered in fallen leaves and low undergrowth spanning the bottom of the frame. Heavy fog drifting between the trees, muted cold palette of deep green, grey-brown bark and pale mist.

assets.name: A Fei's House Interior
assets.description: Flat head-on elevation of the inside of a small rural Chinese living room, drawn like a theatre backdrop. Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain cream wall band, one straight wooden shelf running edge to edge holding a few simple household items, a band with one plain wooden table and a couple of simple wooden chairs standing at the same height, and a flat wooden floor strip across the bottom. Every piece of furniture drawn face-on at the same scale, no receding side wall visible, every horizontal line unbroken from the left edge to the right edge. Warm muted palette of cream and brown wood tones.

assets.name: Woven Shopping Basket
assets.description: A round woven wicker shopping basket with two curved carrying handles arching over the top, holding a few simple wrapped cloth bundles and a couple of vegetables poking out from inside.

assets.name: Forest Boulder
assets.description: A single large rounded grey boulder half-covered in patches of moss, resting alone on bare ground, flat mottled grey stone surface, roughly the size a person could sit down on.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI (2026-08-03): người dùng quyết định cảnh "ngồi xuống tảng đá lớn" nên vẽ thẳng tảng đá VÀO trong 1 Background hoàn chỉnh (xem "Forest Clearing With Boulder" bên dưới) thay vì tách riêng thành Prop rồi ghép sau. Đừng dùng entry Prop này nữa.

assets.name: Forest Ridge Overlook
assets.description: A dramatic misty forest overlook, no people, pure scenic wide shot. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of a dense forest treeline filling the top of the frame with dark green treetops on brown trunks, midground layer of a tall eroded dirt and clay embankment face running the full width of the frame with varied earthy brown tones and shadowed crevices, foreground layer of low green bushes and drifting pale mist along the very bottom edge. Muted earthy palette of brown clay, dark green foliage and soft white mist.
assets.notes: LỖI THỜI (2026-08-03): người dùng thấy ảnh thiếu đường đi. Đã tạo lại có thêm đường mòn dưới tên "Forest Ridge Overlook V2". Đừng dùng entry này nữa.

assets.name: Forest Ridge Overlook V2
assets.description: A dramatic misty forest overlook, no people, pure scenic wide shot. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of a dense forest treeline filling the top of the frame with dark green treetops on brown trunks, midground layer of a tall eroded dirt and clay embankment face running the full width of the frame with varied earthy brown tones and shadowed crevices, foreground layer of a narrow dirt trail path running along the base of the embankment from the far left edge to the far right edge, bordered by low green bushes and drifting pale mist along the very bottom edge. Muted earthy palette of brown clay, dark green foliage and soft white mist.

assets.name: Forest Waterfall Meadow
assets.description: A hidden waterfall in a misty mountain valley, no people, pure scenic wide shot. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of a dense forest treeline along the top of the frame with a faint pale mountain silhouette peeking between the trees, midground layer of two tall grey rock cliff faces flanking a narrow waterfall dropping straight down between them, foreground layer of a flat green grassy meadow spanning the full width of the frame with a couple of smooth grey rocks at the base of the waterfall. Cool palette of grey stone, pale blue water and soft green grass.

assets.name: Forest Clearing With Boulder
assets.description: A small forest clearing, drawn like a theatre backdrop. Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a dense forest treeline filling the upper portion of the frame with dark green treetops, brown trunks and darker green bushes along the tree line, and a flat dirt clearing floor strip across the bottom, no sky visible. Sitting on the left side of the clearing floor, in front of the treeline, one cluster of two or three large rounded grey boulders half-covered in patches of moss, big enough for a person to sit down on. The rest of the clearing floor stays open and empty. Muted palette of deep green foliage, brown dirt and grey stone.

assets.name: Forest Clearing With Boulder Night
assets.description: The same small forest clearing as "Forest Clearing With Boulder" but at night, drawn like a theatre backdrop. Horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a dense forest treeline filling the upper portion of the frame, dark navy night sky with a few small pale stars just visible through gaps between the treetops, and a flat dark dirt clearing floor strip across the bottom, no other sky visible. Sitting on the left side of the clearing floor, in front of the treeline, one cluster of two or three large rounded grey boulders half-covered in patches of moss, big enough for a person to sit down on, same shape and position as the day version. The rest of the clearing floor stays open and empty. Dark cold nighttime palette of deep navy, charcoal and muted moonlit blue-grey.

assets.name: Don Decker
assets.description: a young man in his late twenties wearing a plain light grey short-sleeve button-front shirt with a plain collar, worn as one single layer with no jacket over it, and plain dark navy trousers with plain dark shoes, short dark brown hair combed flat with no parting and no loose strands, clean-shaven with no beard and no moustache
assets.notes: Bản ĐỒ THƯỜNG của Don — dùng cho mọi cảnh BÊN TRONG nhà Bob (đã thay đồ để ở lại qua đêm) và cảnh bước ra khỏi nhà. Cảnh trong tù dùng 'Don Decker Prison', cảnh đám tang + lúc tới cửa nhà Bob dùng 'Don Decker Funeral'.

assets.name: Bob
assets.description: a man in his thirties wearing a plain rust-brown long-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbow, worn as one single layer with no jacket over it, and plain blue denim trousers with plain dark shoes, short dark curly hair, a thick full moustache and no beard

assets.name: Crowned Old Man

assets.notes: Hồn ma ông nội hiện trong gương. Đặt tên trung tính (không gọi là 'grandfather's ghost') để mô tả gọn và tránh chữ dễ dính bộ lọc.

assets.name: Landlord

assets.name: Patrol Officer
assets.description: a police officer wearing a plain dark navy uniform shirt with a plain silver badge on the chest and plain dark navy uniform trousers with a plain black belt, a plain dark navy peaked cap on the head, short black hair, clean-shaven with no beard
assets.notes: Tên KHÔNG dùng 'Police Officer' vì case 1 đã chiếm tên đó — tên asset phải duy nhất toàn tập.

assets.name: Prison Guard
assets.description: a uniformed guard wearing a plain light tan long-sleeve uniform shirt with plain shoulder epaulettes and plain dark brown uniform trousers with a plain black belt, no hat, short blond hair combed to one side, clean-shaven with no beard

assets.name: Chief Warden
assets.description: an older official wearing a plain charcoal grey suit jacket over a plain white shirt with a plain dark red necktie, and plain charcoal grey trousers with plain black shoes, no hat, short grey hair combed straight back, clean-shaven with no beard

assets.name: Cellmate
assets.description: a young man wearing a plain faded blue prison shirt buttoned to the neck as one single layer and plain faded blue prison trousers with plain canvas shoes, short black hair shaved close at the sides, a thin moustache and no beard

assets.name: Priest
assets.description: a priest wearing a plain long black cassock buttoned down the front and reaching the ankles as one single layer, with a plain white clerical collar at the neck, plain black shoes, no hat, short dark hair, clean-shaven with no beard

assets.name: Bob's Wife
assets.description: a woman in her thirties wearing a plain mustard-yellow long-sleeve blouse and a plain brown knee-length skirt as one single layer with no jacket or apron over it, plain flat shoes, brown hair tied back in a neat low bun with no loose strands falling at the sides, simple round eyes with no eyeliner

assets.name: Prison Cell 1983
assets.description: A narrow prison cell interior from 1983 seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale grey concrete ceiling band across the top, a plain pale grey concrete back wall filling the middle with one small square barred window set high in it, a plain metal bunk bed with two flat mattress slabs standing against the left side and a plain steel washbasin block against the right side, and a plain flat grey concrete floor strip running edge to edge across the bottom. The bunk bed and the washbasin stand ON the floor strip and must touch it, not float. Cold palette of pale grey and washed blue, plain flat institutional daylight.

assets.name: Cemetery Funeral Ground
assets.description: A quiet flat cemetery on open ground. Layered flat-depth composition: background layer of a low row of dark green trees all at the same height along the far edge under a plain overcast pale grey sky, midground layer of a row of plain simple rectangular headstones all at the same height standing side by side, foreground layer of a plain flat green grass strip spanning the bottom of the frame with one plain rectangular open grave pit and one plain low mound of brown earth beside it. Muted overcast palette of grey, dark green and brown, daytime.

assets.name: Bob House Exterior
assets.description: The front of a small two-storey American suburban house from 1983 seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain pale grey overcast sky band across the top, a plain pitched dark grey roof band, a plain pale yellow clapboard front wall filling the middle with one plain white front door at the centre and one plain square window on each side, a plain low wooden porch step, and a plain flat concrete path with a plain green lawn strip running edge to edge across the bottom. The house wall must be scaled and positioned to completely fill the frame from the far left edge to the far right edge, with absolutely no gap of open lawn or empty sky at either side edge beside the house. Plain flat daylight, daytime.

assets.name: Bob Bathroom
assets.description: A small American bathroom from 1983 seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain white ceiling band across the top, a plain pale mint-green tiled wall filling the middle with one large plain rectangular mirror mounted at the centre and a plain white sink basin directly below the mirror, a plain white bathtub standing along the right side, and a plain flat white tiled floor strip running edge to edge across the bottom. The mirror must be drawn as one plain empty rectangle with a flat pale silver surface and absolutely nothing reflected in it. The sink and the bathtub stand ON the floor strip and must touch it. Plain flat indoor lighting, daytime.
assets.notes: Gương CỐ Ý để trống hoàn toàn — để cảnh ghép sau đặt 'Crowned Old Man' vào đúng khung gương đó.

assets.name: Bob Living Room
assets.description: A modest American living room from 1983 seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain white ceiling band across the top, a plain warm beige wall filling the middle with one plain rectangular framed picture hung at the centre and one plain square window to one side, a plain brown two-seat sofa and one plain brown armchair standing side by side along the wall, and a plain flat olive-green carpet strip running edge to edge across the bottom. The sofa and the armchair stand ON the carpet strip and must touch it. Warm muted palette of beige, brown and olive, plain flat indoor lighting, daytime, everything completely dry.

assets.name: Bob Living Room Night
assets.description: The same modest American living room from 1983 seen straight on, at night. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain white ceiling band across the top with one plain round warm-yellow ceiling lamp at the centre, a plain warm beige wall filling the middle with one plain rectangular framed picture hung at the centre and one plain square window to one side drawn as a flat dark navy rectangle, a plain brown two-seat sofa and one plain brown armchair standing side by side along the wall, and a plain flat olive-green carpet strip running edge to edge across the bottom. Night palette: everything darker and cooler than a daytime version, lit only by the plain warm yellow lamp. Plain flat indoor lighting, no gradients.

assets.name: Bob Kitchen
assets.description: A small American kitchen from 1983 seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain white ceiling band across the top, a plain pale blue wall filling the middle with a plain row of simple flat wooden upper cabinets, a plain white countertop with one plain steel sink set into it running across, a plain white refrigerator standing at one side, and a plain flat chequered vinyl floor strip running edge to edge across the bottom. The row of cabinets and the countertop must fill the frame from the far left edge to the far right edge with no gap of bare wall at either side edge. The refrigerator stands ON the floor strip and must touch it. Plain flat indoor lighting, daytime.

assets.name: Warden Office
assets.description: A prison chief warden's office from 1983 seen straight on. Built from horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: a plain white ceiling band across the top, a plain pale olive wall filling the middle with one plain rectangular framed certificate and one plain round wall clock hung on it, a plain heavy dark wooden desk standing across the centre with one plain wooden chair behind it, a plain grey filing cabinet standing at one side, and a plain flat dark brown wooden floor strip running edge to edge across the bottom. The desk and the filing cabinet stand ON the floor strip and must touch it. Plain flat indoor lighting, daytime, everything completely dry.

assets.name: Don Decker Prison
assets.description: a young man in his late twenties wearing a plain dark grey-blue prison shirt with a plain collar buttoned to the neck, worn as one single layer with no jacket over it, and plain matching dark grey-blue prison trousers with plain canvas shoes, short dark brown hair combed flat with no parting and no loose strands, clean-shaven with no beard and no moustache
assets.notes: Bản ĐỒNG PHỤC TÙ của Don — dùng cho mọi cảnh trong tù. Cùng mặt/tóc với 'Don Decker' và 'Don Decker Funeral', chỉ khác trang phục.

assets.name: Don Decker Funeral
assets.description: a young man in his late twenties wearing a plain black single-breasted suit jacket over a plain white shirt with a plain black necktie, and plain black suit trousers with plain black shoes, short dark brown hair combed flat with no parting and no loose strands, clean-shaven with no beard and no moustache
assets.notes: Bản MẶC VEST của Don — dùng cho cảnh đám tang và cảnh tới nhà Bob (đi thẳng từ đám tang sang, chưa kịp thay đồ).

assets.name: Grandfather In Suit
assets.description: an old man wearing a plain dark navy single-breasted suit jacket over a plain white shirt with a plain dark grey necktie, no hat, short neatly combed white hair, a short trimmed white beard and a white moustache
assets.notes: Ông nội lúc còn sống — CHỈ dùng làm ảnh tưởng niệm đặt bên mộ trong cảnh đám tang. Để râu trắng ngắn cho đọc ra cùng một người với 'Crowned Old Man' (bản hồn ma đội vương miện, râu dài) mà vẫn gọn gàng đúng kiểu ảnh thờ.
